title: AI Wizards at EXIST 2026: Hierarchical Soft-Label Learning for Multimodal Sexism Identification in Memes

bias_targets.methodology: Hierarchical conditional multi-task classification using pre-computed vision-language embeddings (Gemini Embedding 2) and a Gated MLP to predict empirical annotator soft-label distributions for sexism identification, intention detection, and fine-grained sexism categorization in multimodal memes.
